subject: Request for action on waste dumps in Jodhpur assembly constituency (JunkSnap area report)
body:
To the Commissioner, Jodhpur Municipal Corporation.

Residents have reported waste dumps in Jodhpur assembly constituency: 12 reports from 9 people at 3 sites since 8 October 2026, 11 of them verified.

Sites with the most verified reports:
- site_jdh_1: a waste dump on a vacant plot, 6 verified reports, open since 9 October 2026

The relevant provisions read:

Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 (S.O. 388(E), 27 January 2026, in force 1 April 2026), rule 15(1):
"SAMPLE QUOTE for mock mode; the real text comes from the hashed official copy."

We request that these sites be cleared and that bins or collection points be provided nearby.

This letter is filed by a resident. A copy goes for attention to the MLA for Jodhpur.
